title: Can GPT-4 translate literature?
summary: Tom Gally, a former professional translator and University of Tokyo professor, discusses in March 2023 whether GPT-4 and similar models could translate literary and popular fiction. He gives his assessment of Japanese-to-English quality.
why: Cited as an expert's first-hand evidence that GPT translation is near human quality for distant language pairs.

quote.text: the basic quality of the translation [from Japanese to English] is as good as a human might do
